name: Gemini
summary: Google's assistant, at its best where it can reach into Search, Docs, Gmail and Drive with your permission.
description:
Gemini is worth evaluating on integration rather than on a benchmark: it can ground answers in live search, act across Workspace apps, and read what you already have in Drive. For people whose work lives in Google's suite that shortens real tasks — summarising a thread, drafting from a doc, answering something that changed this morning.

Outside that orbit the advantage narrows, and the account-level permissions it asks for are a genuine decision rather than a formality. Long-context claims and shipping features are different things; the useful test is a task you actually do weekly, checked against what the plan you can buy allows.
